confirmSelf: A self viewing: when you confirm, getproperty issues one door code for the unit and the building door. The visitor sees it only inside the time window; you never see it. You can end the access at any time.

availability.offTitle: Self viewing is not available yet
availability.offBody: Letting verified renters view alone with a time-limited door code opens once the insurance cover and the visitor terms are settled. Until then every viewing is shown by you or your staff.
availability.onBody: Renters who verified their identity and phone book a self window. You confirm each booking; the door code works from {early} minutes before the start to {minutes} minutes after, only on a vacant unit with a smart lock. You never see the code.
availability.onBodyPlain: Renters who verified their identity and phone book a self window. You confirm each booking; the door code works only around the start time, only on a vacant unit with a smart lock. You never see the code.

access.title: Door access
access.overstayBody: The code stopped working at {time} but the visitor has not left yet. Call them, or end the access.
access.insideBody: They let themselves in with their code. You will get a notice if they report a problem or stay too long.
access.noCode: The door code is shown only to the visitor, inside the window. It never appears in this console.
access.endTitle: End this visitor's door access now?
access.endBody: The code stops working on every lock at once. Use it if plans changed or something is wrong. The visitor is told the viewing ended.

log.title: Entry log
log.audited: Every time you open this log it is recorded. Codes are never shown.
log.noEvents: No door has been opened yet.
log.retention: Closed entry logs are deleted after the period the platform keeps them.

calendar.title: Viewing calendar
calendar.description: Every viewing this week, shown by you or self viewing with a door code.

calendar.urgentBody: A visitor reported a problem or is still inside after their time. Open the calendar to see who.
